title: tests/shipped.paths has two readers, the snapshot builder and the workroom scan, and they disagree on what an exclude line is
body:
tests/shipped.paths is the one list of what devbin's public snapshot ships (ST0010, decision 52), and two readers parse it: 0239's snapshot builder and the workroom scan. They select the same files today, but they disagree on what an exclude line is, so the scan's own checks on the list can pass a line they do not understand. The audit needs the scanned set and the shipped set to come from one reading of one list. Raised by cc while reworking 0239, and measured by vc on 2026-10-27, on main at 49278183 and on cc's 0239 bank 752d37b5.

## Measured

- **The builder** (0239, lib/cmd/release, `_snapshot_specs` and `_snapshot_is_exclude`) drops blank lines and lines whose first non-space character is `#`. It counts `:!x`, `:^x` and long magic naming exclude, such as `:(exclude)x` or `:(top,exclude)x`, as excludes. It uses that only to refuse an include line that matches no file.
- **workroom.bats** reads the same list in `_workroom_files` (:51-63), with the same line rule. Its validity arms classify each spec themselves, and they recognise `:(exclude)` alone:
  - :141 checks that every include names a tracked file. A `:!x` line would be checked there as an include, and `git ls-files -- ':!x'` lists every other file, so it would pass.
  - :152 checks that every exclusion excludes. It would skip a `:!x` line, so that exclusion would go unchecked.
- **Both hand the specs to `git ls-files`,** so git decides the selection, and the shipped and scanned sets agree today. tests/shipped.paths writes every exclude as `:(exclude)` (lines 23-26).

## Fix

One reader in lib/helpers gives the list's specs, and whether a spec excludes. The builder and workroom.bats both ask it, and neither keeps its own.

## Done when

1. The builder and workroom.bats take the list's specs and the exclude test from the one reader in lib/helpers.
2. workroom.bats's include and exclusion arms classify every exclude spelling git accepts. An arm holds a fixture list with a `:!x` line, checked as an exclusion.
3. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (workroom.bats, releasesnapshot.bats and helpers.bats, with the tree scans and help), and CI is green on the pushed head.

It builds after 0239 lands, and lands before ST0010's audit reads the snapshot.

## Resolution

Fixed at e0301ca32a9c6d062121c3aa60845b46a34b7aa8, landed on main by vc with the rest of C (fb66b479..7565e2a2) on hv's GO of 29 Oct, as cc banked it. tests/shipped.paths has one reader, in lib/helpers, and the snapshot builder (0239) and the workroom scan both read through it.

- **The reader.** `pathlist_specs` gives a list's specs: every line as written, but a blank one or one whose first non-space character is `#`. `pathspec_excludes` says whether a spec leaves paths out. `pathspec_kept_out` gives an exclusion with its exclude magic taken off, so git lists what it keeps out; it always writes the magic, empty when nothing is left of it (`::x`, `:()x`), so an exclusion of a path opening with `:`, or of everything (`:!`), still lists what it keeps out.
- **Every exclude spelling git accepts.** `pathspec_excludes` reads short magic holding `!` or `^` in any order with `/` (`:!x`, `:^x`, `:/!x`, `:!/x`, `:!:x`, `:/^x`, `:^:x`) and long magic naming exclude among its words (`:(exclude)x`, `:(,exclude)x`, `:(top,exclude)x`, `:(exclude,glob)x`, `:(icase,exclude)x`). The builder's own test had missed `:/!x`, which it would have checked as an include line.
- **One reader, no copies.** The builder's own `_snapshot_specs` and `_snapshot_is_exclude` are gone, and releasesnapshot.bats's oracle reads the list's lines through `pathlist_specs` too. workroom.bats's `_workroom_files`, its include arm and its exclusion arm read through the helpers; the exclusion arm lists what each exclusion keeps out through `pathspec_kept_out`, not by stripping `:(exclude)`, and reads git's listing into a variable, refusing when git refuses, where a loop over a process substitution had read a failure as nothing kept out.

- **Done when 1.** lib/cmd/release's snapshot_build and its history check read each list through `pathlist_specs`, and the builder's check that an include line matches a file asks `pathspec_excludes`; workroom.bats's `_workroom_files`, and its arm "tests/shipped.paths lists the shipped tree, and every entry it includes names a tracked file (0216)", which holds both the include and the exclusion checks, call them too. Neither keeps a reader of its own.
- **Done when 2.** workroom.bats's arm "a path list's every exclude spelling is read as one, by the one reader the snapshot builder reads with, and keeps out what git keeps out (0261)" reads a fixture list, with a comment and a blank line, through `pathlist_specs`. Its specs are the exclude spellings above, `:!b/x` among them, `:!::q` (a path opening with `:`) and `:!` (everything), beside includes that look like them (`b/x`, `:/b/x`, `:(top)b/`, `:(glob)c/*`, `:::q`). Each is classified by `pathspec_excludes` and held to git's own answer in a fixture repository: an include keeps out nothing, since git lists it beside `:/` as every file; each exclusion's `pathspec_kept_out` spec lists exactly what git leaves out beside `:/`. A row may name the directory git runs in, so `top` changes the answer, and the fixture's files make `glob` and `icase` change it too. It counts the specs it checked against the list's own count.
- **Done when 3.** The landing suite: C's arms phase, in estate slot 01M61TNPWJTZMYNDBPTEZZ54ZG on molt-vc's grant, ran every arm tagged with one of the bank's eight issues on main 09c7d61a, file by file, from 2026-10-28 18:00Z to 18:08Z: in the red clone f4b30a50, main's lib with the bank's tests, under BSD; then at the bank's tip 53c92332 under BSD, and again with GNU coreutils, findutils, sed and grep first on PATH (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s5e/runs/arms/, summary in s5e/arms.out). 0261's arm failed in the red clone and passed under BSD and GNU. C was stopped on hv's word in its light phase, so its whole-file legs, the tree scans among them, did not finish; hv's runs on main took them over. No later fix touched its code. hv's `dvb test all` on rhadamanth at 217adf65 ran every one of the 2777 tests bats counts in tests/unit once, and none failed (tmp/test/20261029-0817.bats.out, its .errors empty). K0116B, the full suite on kovacs at 4d1a76b0 with rustup's cargo first on PATH, as on CI's Ubuntu runner, is green, as vc read its seal. CI run 40851772728 on 4d1a76b0 and CI run 40860048152 on 25175386, the head 0.1.16 was cut from, are green on Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary. No critic leg ran on the landed commits.

- **CI:** run 40860048152 on the pushed head 25175386, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
